quarter_session_justices.name: Justices at Quarter Sessions
quarter_session_justices.observation: Four times a year the country gentlemen sit as justices, try thefts and brawls, and fix the wages of labourers.

two_chamber_estates.name: Two-chamber Estates
two_chamber_estates.observation: The lords now sit in their own hall, and the knights and townsmen deliberate apart before bringing their answer.
two_chamber_estates.ability_reason: Lords and commons sit apart; the commons gain a voice of their own on taxes and grievances that the ruler must hear.
two_chamber_estates.social_consequence: The commons learn to bargain grants of money for the redress of grievances

town_league_diet.name: League Diet
town_league_diet.observation: Delegates of the league towns meet in the chief port and bind every member to a trade embargo.

commons_speaker_office.name: Speaker of the Commons
commons_speaker_office.observation: The commons choose one of their number to carry their grievances to the throne, and he kneels to speak for all.

estates_impeachment.name: Impeachment of Ministers
estates_impeachment.observation: The commons accuse the chancellor before the lords, and a minister falls for his peculation.

hereditary_town_signory.name: Hereditary Town Lordship
hereditary_town_signory.observation: Tired of faction, the commune hands its rule to one captain, and his son inherits the town.
hereditary_town_signory.social_consequence: Old commune families are exiled or bought off

poll_tax_per_head.name: Poll Tax
poll_tax_per_head.observation: Every head over fifteen pays the same coin, and the villagers who hide their daughters are fined.
poll_tax_per_head.social_consequence: The same tax on rich and poor provokes risings in the villages

regency_council.name: Regency Council
regency_council.observation: A council of uncles and high priests governs for the child ruler until he comes of age.

pleaded_case_reports.name: Case Reports
pleaded_case_reports.observation: Clerks write down the pleadings and judgments of each term, and lawyers cite last year's cases in court.

municipal_exchange_bank.name: Town Exchange Bank
municipal_exchange_bank.observation: The town guarantees the deposits of its exchange bank, and merchants pay each other by a transfer in its books.

lawyers_training_inns.name: Lawyers' Inns
lawyers_training_inns.observation: Young men live, dine and argue moots together in the lawyers' inns before they are called to plead.

creditor_debt_house.name: House of Creditors
creditor_debt_house.observation: The city's creditors run its debt as a house of their own, with shares that pass by sale or inheritance.

conciliar_supremacy.name: Great Councils Above the Head
conciliar_supremacy.observation: A great council of the god's house deposes rival heads and declares itself above any single one.

equity_conscience_court.name: Court of Conscience
equity_conscience_court.observation: When the hard letter of the law would ruin a widow, the chancellor's court may order what conscience requires.

salt_and_drink_excise.name: Salt and Drink Excise
salt_and_drink_excise.observation: Gaugers measure every cask and salt pan, and the tax rides on what the poor eat and drink.

banker_family_signory.name: Banker Family Rule
banker_family_signory.observation: The councils still meet, but every office goes to friends of the great banking house, which lends to the town and to princes.

permanent_army_tax.name: Permanent Army Tax
permanent_army_tax.observation: The estates grant a yearly tax without term to pay companies of horse and foot in the ruler's service.
permanent_army_tax.ability_reason: A standing force paid from a permanent tax gives generals trained companies all year instead of levies raised for each war.
permanent_army_tax.social_consequence: Townsmen resent soldiers billeted among them, and the estates lose their hold over war

resident_ambassadors.name: Resident Ambassadors
resident_ambassadors.observation: A resident envoy lives at the foreign court with his household and writes home every week.
resident_ambassadors.ability_reason: Permanent envoys give the ruler steady news and a standing channel for treaties, so wars can be foreseen and bargained away.

balance_of_power_league.name: Balance-of-power League
balance_of_power_league.observation: Five realms swear a league for twenty-five years that none shall be allowed to swallow the rest.

envoy_credentials_immunity.name: Credentials and Immunity
envoy_credentials_immunity.observation: The envoy presents sealed letters of credence, and his person and his house are not to be touched.

charitable_pawn_banks.name: Charitable Pawn Banks
charitable_pawn_banks.observation: Mendicant preachers found pawn banks lending to the poor at low interest against a cloak or a pot.

composite_realm_union.name: Union of Realms by Marriage
composite_realm_union.observation: Two crowns rest on one head, but each realm keeps its own estates, coins and laws.

town_brotherhood_police.name: Brotherhood Road Police
town_brotherhood_police.observation: Each hundred households pays for mounted brothers who hunt highwaymen on the roads.

orthodoxy_tribunal.name: Tribunal for Dissenters
orthodoxy_tribunal.observation: The tribunal's familiars take a converted merchant for questioning, and his goods are sequestered in the meantime.
orthodoxy_tribunal.social_consequence: Neighbours denounce neighbours, and learned men write more carefully

specialized_royal_councils.name: Councils for Finance and War
specialized_royal_councils.observation: The great council divides into councils for finance, war, the provinces and the sea, each with its own secretaries.
specialized_royal_councils.ability_reason: Specialized councils give each field of government its own expertise and records, so policy no longer waits on one crowded table.

prerogative_council_court.name: Council as Court
prerogative_council_court.observation: Great men who overawe juries are tried in the ruler's council chamber, where there is no jury to overawe.

poor_petition_court.name: Court of Requests
poor_petition_court.observation: A poor man's petition is heard for free by a master of requests, without the long pleadings of the common courts.

perpetual_public_peace.name: Perpetual Public Peace
perpetual_public_peace.observation: Private feud is banned forever, and a realm court is founded to judge the quarrels of princes and knights.

regional_peace_circles.name: Peace Circles
regional_peace_circles.observation: The realm is divided into circles, each bound to raise a contingent and enforce the peace inside its borders.

secretaries_of_state.name: Secretaries of State
secretaries_of_state.observation: Two secretaries sign the ruler's letters and keep his papers, and every minister's business passes through their office.
secretaries_of_state.ability_reason: Secretaries who sign for the ruler turn the household into a ministry; business moves by letter at the ruler's pace, not the court's.

venal_office_sales.name: Sold Offices
venal_office_sales.observation: Judgeships and tax offices are sold for life and may be passed to a son on payment of a yearly fee.
venal_office_sales.social_consequence: Merchants' sons buy their way into the robe, and offices become family property

reason_of_state_treatise.name: Reason of State
reason_of_state_treatise.observation: A former secretary writes that the prince may do what the safety of the state requires, whatever his priest says.

realm_criminal_code.name: Realm Criminal Code
realm_criminal_code.observation: One code sets the crimes, the procedure and the penalties for the whole realm, from the capital to the far march.
realm_criminal_code.ability_reason: One written criminal code and procedure makes justice predictable and the ruler's courts reach every province.
realm_criminal_code.social_consequence: The code allows torture to obtain confession, and local customs of composition vanish

crown_seizes_temple_lands.name: Crown Takes the God's House Lands
crown_seizes_temple_lands.observation: Commissioners take the retreat houses' lands for the crown and sell them to courtiers; the ruler now names the god's high priests.
crown_seizes_temple_lands.social_consequence: Retreat devotees are turned out, and their libraries and almshouses scattered

overseas_viceroyalties.name: Overseas Viceroyalties
overseas_viceroyalties.observation: A viceroy governs the far provinces with his own high court, and appeals take a year to reach the capital.

press_licensing_censors.name: Press Licensing
press_licensing_censors.observation: No book may be printed without a licence, and the censor reads every sheet before it goes to press.
press_licensing_censors.social_consequence: Forbidden books are printed abroad and smuggled in bales of cloth

privy_council_minutes.name: Privy Council Minutes
privy_council_minutes.observation: A clerk sits at the foot of the privy council table and writes down every decision and who was present.

ruler_chooses_rite.name: Each Ruler Sets the Rite
ruler_chooses_rite.observation: The peace of the realm allows each prince to set the rite of his own lands; dissenters may sell up and move.
ruler_chooses_rite.social_consequence: Minority families must convert or migrate across the border

tax_farming_leases.name: Tax Farming
tax_farming_leases.observation: Financiers pay the crown in advance for the right to collect the customs, and take what they can.
tax_farming_leases.social_consequence: Tax farmers grow rich and are hated in every market

sovereignty_doctrine.name: Undivided Sovereignty
sovereignty_doctrine.observation: A jurist writes that in every state there must be one power that gives the law and receives it from none.

provincial_union_estates.name: Union of Provinces
provincial_union_estates.observation: The united provinces send deputies to a joint assembly that raises taxes, fits out fleets and makes war.
provincial_union_estates.ability_reason: A union governed by joint estates can raise credit and fleets on the consent of the provinces, without a crowned head.
provincial_union_estates.social_consequence: Each province keeps its veto, and every decision must be bargained town by town

deposition_of_tyrant.name: Deposition of a Tyrant
deposition_of_tyrant.observation: The estates declare that the ruler has broken his compact and is no longer their lord.

rite_toleration_edict.name: Edict of Toleration
rite_toleration_edict.observation: An edict allows the minority rite to worship in named towns and gives its members access to office.

joint_stock_company.name: Joint-stock Company
joint_stock_company.observation: Merchants buy shares in a chartered company that sends fleets to the far seas and pays dividends from the cargoes.
joint_stock_company.ability_reason: Pooled capital in transferable shares funds voyages too large and risky for any single house.
joint_stock_company.social_consequence: Shareholders who never sail grow rich or ruined by distant cargoes

share_exchange_bourse.name: Share Exchange
share_exchange_bourse.observation: Shares of the great company change hands every noon in the courtyard of the merchants' exchange.

city_exchange_bank.name: City Exchange Bank
city_exchange_bank.observation: The city bank's money of account never changes weight, and bills across the continent are settled in it.

free_seas_doctrine.name: Freedom of the Seas
free_seas_doctrine.observation: A jurist argues that the sea, like the air, belongs to no one and may be sailed by all.

settler_self_government_compact.name: Settlers' Compact
settler_self_government_compact.observation: Before landing, the settlers sign a compact to form a civil body and obey the laws they make together.

invention_patent_statute.name: Patents for Inventions
invention_patent_statute.observation: Monopolies are forbidden except for the true inventor of a new manufacture, who may hold it for fourteen years.

law_of_war_and_peace.name: Law of War and Peace
law_of_war_and_peace.observation: A jurist in exile sets out when war is just, how prisoners must be treated, and how treaties bind.

petition_of_right.name: Petition of Right
petition_of_right.observation: The commons force the ruler to accept that no man may be taxed without their consent or imprisoned without cause shown.

provincial_intendants.name: Royal Intendants
provincial_intendants.observation: Commissioners sent from the capital oversee taxes, police and justice in each province and can be recalled at will.
provincial_intendants.ability_reason: Revocable commissioners carry the ruler's will into every province, bypassing the hereditary officers.
provincial_intendants.social_consequence: Provincial nobles and office-holders lose their say, and resent it

cameral_domain_chambers.name: Treasury Chambers
cameral_domain_chambers.observation: Treasury chambers audit the crown's forests, mines and farms and keep them in profit.

sovereign_realms_congress.name: Peace Congress
sovereign_realms_congress.observation: After thirty years of war, envoys of every realm meet in two towns and agree borders that each will respect.
sovereign_realms_congress.ability_reason: Realms recognize each other's borders and sovereignty; wars end by treaty, and a common diplomacy of equals begins.

estates_rule_without_ruler.name: Estates Rule Alone
estates_rule_without_ruler.observation: The ruler is beheaded, and the estates govern by committees and a council of state.

written_frame_of_government.name: Written Frame of Government
written_frame_of_government.observation: A single written instrument sets out who governs, how the estates are elected and what no ruler may do.
written_frame_of_government.ability_reason: A written frame of government fixes the powers of each office, so succession and taxation no longer depend on one ruler's word.

restoration_amnesty.name: Restoration with Pardon
restoration_amnesty.observation: The heir returns to the throne, and an act of pardon covers all but those who signed his father's death.

personal_rule_ministers.name: Personal Rule
personal_rule_ministers.observation: The ruler abolishes the chief minister's post and works at his desk through secretaries each morning.

mercantile_trade_council.name: Council of Trade
mercantile_trade_council.observation: A council of trade sets tariffs, founds royal glass and cloth works and inspects the weaving towns.

treasury_commission_board.name: Treasury Board
treasury_commission_board.observation: The treasury is put in commission, and five lords audit together what one treasurer once hid.

war_ministry_bureaus.name: War Ministry Bureaus
war_ministry_bureaus.observation: Bureaus for pay, bread, quarters and arms keep registers of every company, so generals are supplied without looting.

test_oath_for_office.name: Test Oath
test_oath_for_office.observation: Every office-holder must take the realm rite's sacrament and swear against the rival doctrine.
test_oath_for_office.social_consequence: Dissenters are shut out of office, the universities and the town corporations

habeas_writ.name: Writ Against Imprisonment
habeas_writ.observation: A judge's writ orders the jailer to bring the prisoner and the cause of his arrest before the court.

estates_parties.name: Parties in the Estates
estates_parties.observation: The estates split into two named factions, each with its clubs, pamphleteers and toasts.

grand_palace_court.name: Grand Palace Court
grand_palace_court.observation: The court moves to a vast palace in the country, where nobles who once raised armies now compete to hand the ruler his shirt.
grand_palace_court.ability_reason: Drawing the high nobility into a ritual court keeps them from their provinces and their private armies.
grand_palace_court.social_consequence: Nobles ruin themselves on court dress, while the capital's crowds feel the ruler has left them

conditional_crown_settlement.name: Crown Settled on Conditions
conditional_crown_settlement.observation: The estates offer the crown to a new couple on the condition that they rule by the laws the estates declare.

realm_bill_of_rights.name: Bill of Rights
realm_bill_of_rights.observation: A statute declares that no army may be kept in peace, and no tax raised, without the consent of the estates.
realm_bill_of_rights.ability_reason: Army and taxes need the estates' consent; the ruler's credit rises because his promises are backed by law.

appropriated_annual_budget.name: Annual Appropriated Budget
appropriated_annual_budget.observation: The estates vote the money each year for named purposes, and the treasury must account for each head.

state_lottery_loans.name: Lottery Loans
state_lottery_loans.observation: The crown sells lottery tickets that pay a small annuity and a chance at a great prize.

chartered_central_bank.name: Chartered Central Bank
chartered_central_bank.observation: A chartered bank lends the whole of its capital to the crown and issues notes that pass as coin.
chartered_central_bank.ability_reason: A bank lending to the state and issuing notes lets the realm borrow cheaply and pay armies and fleets on credit.
chartered_central_bank.social_consequence: Bankers and fundholders gain a stake in the government's survival

fixed_term_estates.name: Fixed-term Estates
fixed_term_estates.observation: Elections to the estates must be held at least every three years, whatever the ruler wishes.

press_licence_lapse.name: End of Press Licensing
press_licence_lapse.observation: The licensing act is not renewed, and printers may print without a censor's leave, answering only for libel.

trade_and_colonies_board.name: Board of Trade and Colonies
trade_and_colonies_board.observation: A board of trade and colonies collects reports from every overseas governor and advises on trade laws.

foreign_affairs_office.name: Foreign Office and Archive
foreign_affairs_office.observation: The foreign office keeps its own archive of treaties and dispatches, and trains young clerks in ciphers.

realm_union_treaty.name: Union of Estates
realm_union_treaty.observation: Two realms dissolve their estates into one, keeping only their separate courts and god's houses.

governing_senate_colleges.name: Senate and Colleges
governing_senate_colleges.observation: A governing senate oversees ministries run as boards of equal members, on a foreign model.

justice_ombudsman.name: Chancellor of Justice
justice_ombudsman.observation: A chancellor of justice may investigate any official and bring him before a court.

succession_sanction.name: Fixed Succession Rule
succession_sanction.observation: A fixed rule of succession, accepted by every province, lets the ruler's daughter inherit all his lands.

debt_sinking_fund.name: Sinking Fund
debt_sinking_fund.observation: A fixed sum is set aside each year to buy back the realm's debt, and the fund's accounts are published.

cadastral_tax_survey.name: Cadastral Survey
cadastral_tax_survey.observation: Surveyors map every parcel with its owner and soil, and tax follows the map instead of the lord's word.
cadastral_tax_survey.social_consequence: Hidden fields come to light, and the privileged lose their exemptions

bubble_company_law.name: Bubble Law
bubble_company_law.observation: After the great crash, no company may sell shares without a charter.

cabinet_first_minister.name: Cabinet and First Minister
cabinet_first_minister.observation: A first minister leads a cabinet that must keep a majority in the estates or resign.
cabinet_first_minister.ability_reason: A cabinet answerable to the estates ties government to the tax-granting body, so policy and money move together.

table_of_service_ranks.name: Table of Ranks
table_of_service_ranks.observation: Fourteen ranks of service, civil, military and court, and reaching the eighth makes a man noble.
table_of_service_ranks.social_consequence: Old nobles must now serve to keep their standing

police_ordinance_science.name: Police Science
police_ordinance_science.observation: Ordinances govern markets, street lamps, fire buckets and the burial of the dead, and inspectors enforce them.

cameral_science_chairs.name: Chairs of Cameral Science
cameral_science_chairs.observation: University chairs teach finance, agriculture and police to young men who will serve as officials.
cameral_science_chairs.ability_reason: Officials trained at university in finance and administration carry a common method into every chamber of the state.

servant_ruler_doctrine.name: First Servant of the State
servant_ruler_doctrine.observation: The ruler writes that he is only the first servant of the state, and he works at his papers from dawn.

separation_of_powers.name: Separation of Powers
separation_of_powers.observation: A magistrate's book argues that liberty lasts only where the power to make law, to execute it and to judge are held apart.
separation_of_powers.ability_reason: Separating lawmaking, execution and judgment checks every office by another, making government less arbitrary.

compiled_civil_code.name: Civil Code
compiled_civil_code.observation: Jurists compile a civil code of persons, property and contracts for the whole realm.

free_grain_trade_doctrine.name: Free Grain Trade
free_grain_trade_doctrine.observation: A physician's economic table shows the net product of the land and argues that grain should move without tolls.
free_grain_trade_doctrine.social_consequence: In a bad year, crowds seize grain carts leaving for distant markets

social_contract_doctrine.name: Social Contract
social_contract_doctrine.observation: A wandering philosopher argues that rule is legitimate only when it follows the general will of the people.

penal_reform_no_torture.name: Penal Reform
penal_reform_no_torture.observation: A treatise argues that punishment should be certain and proportionate, and princes abolish torture.

press_freedom_statute.name: Press Freedom
press_freedom_statute.observation: A statute abolishes censorship and gives the public access to official records.

cameral_service_examinations.name: Merit Examinations
cameral_service_examinations.observation: Candidates for the treasury chambers must pass a written examination before appointment.

declaration_of_rights.name: Declaration of Rights
declaration_of_rights.observation: An assembly declares that men are born free and equal in rights, and that sovereignty rests in the nation.
declaration_of_rights.ability_reason: Rights declared for all subjects bind every office; the law, not birth or favour, now defines the citizen.
declaration_of_rights.social_consequence: Nobles and priests lose privileges, and some flee abroad

constituent_convention.name: Constituent Convention
constituent_convention.observation: An elected convention drafts a constitution and sends it to the people for ratification.

federal_written_constitution.name: Federal Constitution
federal_written_constitution.observation: A federal constitution sets an elected head, two chambers and a supreme court over the member states.
federal_written_constitution.ability_reason: A federal frame shares power between the union and its members; taxes, armies and courts rest on a written contract.

abolition_of_estate_privileges.name: Privileges Abolished
abolition_of_estate_privileges.observation: In one night's session, the nobles and priests surrender their dues, tithes and exemptions.
abolition_of_estate_privileges.social_consequence: Peasants burn the old manor rolls, and lords lose their dues without compensation

single_national_assembly.name: National Assembly
single_national_assembly.observation: The three estates merge into one national assembly and vote by head, not by order.
single_national_assembly.ability_reason: One assembly voting by head gives the commons a majority; the old estates of noble and priest lose their separate veto.

elected_municipal_councils.name: Elected Town Councils
elected_municipal_councils.observation: Every town and village elects a council and a mayor.

uniform_departments.name: Uniform Departments
uniform_departments.observation: The old provinces are replaced by departments of equal size, each with its seat a day's ride from every village.
uniform_departments.social_consequence: Old provincial loyalties and privileges are erased from the map

realm_republic.name: Republic Proclaimed
realm_republic.observation: The ruler is deposed, the crown is abolished and the realm is proclaimed a republic.

emergency_safety_committee.name: Committee of Public Safety
emergency_safety_committee.observation: A committee of twelve rules by decree, and suspects go before revolutionary tribunals.
emergency_safety_committee.social_consequence: Terror stills opposition but leaves every household afraid

general_land_code.name: General Land Law
general_land_code.observation: A general code sets the rights and duties of every subject, estate and trade in nineteen thousand articles.

graduated_income_tax.name: Graduated Income Tax
graduated_income_tax.observation: To pay for the war, every income is taxed at rising rates.
graduated_income_tax.social_consequence: Assessors pry into every household's books
